title: File:Islamabad Police Inspector General.png

title: File:All together, a priceless moment.jpg
description: To be of a Chinese descendant living in Singapore would be to celebrate Chinese New Year with the lo hei tradition. This is a picture of my family's annual lo hei moment. It is priceless and brings me back to my cultural roots. I am absolutely enamored by how this dish, also known as yu sheng, and the practice of mixing the ingredients all the while saying auspicious chinese sayings can bring my whole family together.
